pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions display irregular polygonal and sub-ovoid geometries with soft, low-frequency edge gradients due to motion blur; relative spatial area is largest on the mid-flank and decreases toward the ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space network is composed of continuous light-toned pathways of variable thickness; junction nodes consist primarily of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the desaturated background.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, high-contrast avian silhouette is positioned on the upper neck, dorsal to the scapular region.
